authority.binding_rule: Enqueue is forbidden until an immutable v2 amendment fills only greedy_result_sha256 and records the selected prefixes returned by the valid greedy receipt. No intervention, bar, null, population, or price may change in that amendment.

frozen_design.populations: Use every original and fresh OOD endpoint with the greedy receipt's exact donor pairs and locked temporal bridge/is-was postcue source positions. Original FIT is replay-only because it selected the prefix; causal mediation claims use original HOLDOUT and both OOD phases.
frozen_design.writer_arm: Patch the selected role-specific earlier-head prefix from its exact command-counterfactual donor at only the locked source positions, then capture the resulting L11H3 q/k/q2/k2/v tensors and final logits.
frozen_design.value_mediator_arm: In a separate native execution, replace only L11H3 c_v head 3 at the locked source positions with the values induced by the writer arm. Keep native recipient q/k/q2/k2 and all other components live.
frozen_design.formula_arm: Using recipient-native normalized rotary q/k/q2/k2, contract the writer-induced source-local delta_v as (1-lambda_11) sum_j ((q_i dot k_j)/128)((q2_i dot k2_j)/128) delta_v_j for every destination. Add only this 128-vector tensor to the native L11H3 pre-c_proj slice. No learned projection, DAS basis, coefficient fit, or donor routing factor is permitted.
frozen_design.algebra_gate: The explicit formula must equal the independently observed value-mediator L11H3 preprojection delta with max absolute and relative L2 error <=1e-4. Formula-arm selected logits must match value-mediator selected logits within 1e-4.
frozen_design.writer_replay: The full writer arm must replay every selected-prefix parent-relative metric stored in the greedy receipt within 1e-5.
frozen_design.mediation_bar: Against the full selected-writer causal effect, the formula arm must achieve signed recovery >=0.75, cosine >=0.95, relative residual <=0.50, and direction agreement >=0.90 on original HOLDOUT and both OOD phases for each role. Every validation template must retain recovery >=0.50 and direction agreement >=0.75.
frozen_design.selectivity: Formula-arm command-gold cross-role norm ratio must be <=0.01 on every pooled validation cell. Every is-was formula intervention must change the earlier temporal margin by <=1e-5.
